'''Jestan''' was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE" /> located in the [[Jestan system/Legends|Jestan system]]. It was a part of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Corpheli sector/Legends|Corpheli sector]], being located both in the [[Outer Expansion Zone/Legends|Outer Expansion Zone]] sub-region and the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of that region.<ref name="Location" /> Jestan lay on a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] linking it to the [[Belukat system/Legends|Belukat]] and [[Corphelion system/Legends|Corphelion systems]].<ref name="EGTW" />

At some point by [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' represents a collection of [[in-universe]] reports from "one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]," which corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] prevailed on Jestan in a major battle<ref name="CSWE" /> of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref> that became known as the [[Engagement at Jestan]].<ref name="CSWE" /> Between [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]] and [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], Jestan fell within the borders of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jestan's name was introduced via a mention of the Engagement at Jestan in ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="AIR" /> [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' subsequently established Jestan as a distinct planet.<ref name="CSWE" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Jestan [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet itself, in grid square M-7.<ref name="Location" />
